verdict.rationale: Stripe's own reporting feature, reachable through the agent tool stripe_report, generates downloadable CSV files for financial report types such as balance, payouts, activity, tax and Revenue Recognition. That is a first-party export in an open format, but it covers only a slice of account data. Nothing in the evidence shows a complete account export or tooling for migrating data out to another provider; the subscription-migration doc covers moving into Stripe only. Missing for 10: documented full export of all account data, migration-out or portability tooling (e.g., moving customer/payment data to another processor), open formats beyond CSV reports, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Report runs generate downloadable CSV files.
